data.description: Nothing happens in the dread lord's realm without the dread lord becoming aware. It can use speak with animals, speak with plants, and stone tell as spell-like abilities each three times per day. It can use clairaudience/clairvoyance as a spell-like ability three times per day, and the spell's range extends to any place in its domain.
